title: Stop these 5
items: You only answer in one language.
Voxa answers your callers in 12 Indian languages.
Voxa picks up 24/7 and books into Google Calendar, Outlook or Calendly.
Auto-callback on busy rings the caller back when the line frees up.
Lunch rush means nobody can pick up.
Voxa takes the overflow calls so your staff can serve the people in front of them.
A missed call gets no reply.
Missed-call text-back sends an SMS the moment you can't pick up.
footer: Setup in 4 steps: sign up and describe your business, train it on your FAQs and menu, connect your number and calendar, go live.
